item.title: OpenAI to begin testing ads in ChatGPT in U.S.
item.description: OpenAI has announced plans to begin testing advertising in the United States in the coming weeks, while stressing that ads will not influence responses or compromise user privacy. It has also expanded access to its low-cost ChatGPT Go subscription to the U.S. The ChatGPT parent plans to test ads for logged-in adult users in the U.S. on the free and Go tiers. item.title: Google appeals U.S. antitrust ruling on search monopoly
item.description: Google has appealed a landmark U.S. antitrust ruling that found the company illegally maintained a monopoly in online search. The appeal follows an August 2024 decision by U.S. District Judge Amit Mehta, who ruled that the search giant violated antitrust law. item.title: Thinking Machines Lab announces Soumith Chintala as new CTO
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab, the AI company co-founded by former OpenAI Chief Technology Officer Mira Murati, has announced Soumith Chintala as the new CTO. The changes to its leadership team are followed by several senior departures. Murati said in a post on X that it has parted ways with its CTO, Barret Zoph. item.title: Anthropic appoints Irina Ghose as India Managing Director ahead of office launch
item.description: Anthropic has appointed Irina Ghose as Managing Director for India as the artificial intelligence company prepares to open its first office in the country. Ghose joins Anthropic after serving as MD of Microsoft India, where she led enterprise technology and AI adoption across sectors including banking, healthcare, manufacturing and government. item.title: ting launches dedicated sports marketing division
item.description: India-based advertising agency ting has launched a dedicated sports marketing division, ting Sports, building on over a decade of experience in sports branding and campaigns. Ting Sports will focus on sports marketing across print and digital platforms, with previous work including partnerships with Sunrisers Hyderabad, Kolkata Knight Riders, Manchester City, Chennaiyin FC, Mumbai City FC, Ultimate Table Tennis and Adani Sportsline. item.title: Nissan Motor India appoints Gagan Mangal as Head of Communications
item.description: Nissan Motor India Pvt. Ltd. (NMIPL) has appointed Gagan Mangal as its new Head of Communications, effective January 12, 2026. item.title: Netflix and Sony Pictures sign global Pay-1 film licensing deal
item.description: Netflix and Sony Pictures Entertainment have signed a global Pay-1 licensing agreement that will bring Sony’s feature films to Netflix after their theatrical and home entertainment release windows. Under the exclusive multi-year deal, Sony Pictures Entertainment films will stream on Netflix globally. item.title: What happens to quick commerce advertising when speed stops being the sell?
item.description: The quick commerce industry has recently seen a major intervention. Union Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya has pushed India's quick commerce platforms to remove the 10-minute delivery promise from their branding. Blinkit has complied, quietly replacing the messaging across its app. Other platforms are expected to follow.
